value.answer: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash targets coding and agents with a 50% introductory price cut, offering $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through the end of 2026. The model emphasizes more diligent planning and execution, aiming for fewer retries and less manual supervision. It has achieved a 65.3% DeepSWE score and outperforms previous models in business workflow completion.
